record.title: Unbounded remark length and missing route-level body cap in POST /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/social-autopsy allow multi-megabyte database and workspace payload amplification
record.description: Unlike PUT /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/note (app/routes/api/va_case.py:898-958, which enforces a 64 KB Content-Length cap, rejects NUL characters, and enforces a 20,000-character content limit), POST /api/v1/coding/finalize/<va_sid> (app/routes/api/coding.py:442,611, which enforces a 4,000-character _FREE_TEXT_CAP on remark), and /api/v1/doris-clinical/* (app/routes/api/doris_clinical.py:212-216, which enforces a 32 KB Content-Length cap), POST /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/social-autopsy (save_social_autopsy in app/routes/api/so.py:54-239, mounted at /api/v1/va in app/routes/api/__init__.py:87) enforces no route-specific request.content_length limit and no type or maximum character-length check on the remark field (line 98). Requests are bounded only by Flask's global Config.MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH (default 2 MiB in config.py:137, configurable via the MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH environment variable, behind nginx client_max_body_size 55m in deploy/ingress-routes.conf:7). Note that public-demo accounts on PUB01 cannot reach this sink because app/services/public_demo_service.py:453-454,469-470 enforces social_autopsy_enabled=False and reviewer_social_autopsy_enabled=False, which app/routes/api/so.py:88-95 rejects with 403 forbidden. However, any authenticated coder, coding_tester, reviewer, or admin holding an active coding or reviewing allocation on a project with Social Autopsy enabled can store ~2 MiB strings (or up to MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH if raised in deployment) in VaSocialAutopsyAnalysis.va_saa_remark (sa.Text, app/models/va_social_autopsy_analysis.py:43), which are then echoed in the save response (app/routes/api/so.py:238), serialized in GET /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/workspace (app/routes/api/va_case.py:508,754), rendered into HTML in GET /vaform/<va_sid>/social_autopsy (app/services/case_content_service.py:559-561; app/routes/va_form.py:625), and projected into the mv_submission_analytics materialized view (app/services/submission_analytics_mv.py:945,1125).
record.claimed_root_cause: save_social_autopsy in app/routes/api/so.py:54-239 parses the JSON request body up to the global Config.MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH (default 2 MiB in config.py:137) without a route-level request.content_length cap and writes (data.get('remark') or '').strip() directly to VaSocialAutopsyAnalysis.va_saa_remark (sa.Text) at lines 98, 179, and 196 without verifying isinstance(..., str) or enforcing a character-length bound.

trace.description: POST /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/social-autopsy calls request.get_json(force=True, silent=True) without a route-specific request.content_length check, relying only on global Config.MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH (2 MiB default in config.py:137).
Extracts remark = (data.get('remark') or '').strip() or None without checking isinstance(remark, str), rejecting NUL bytes, or bounding character length.
Assigns the unbounded remark string to analysis.va_saa_remark on an existing active VaSocialAutopsyAnalysis row (or passes va_saa_remark=remark to a new VaSocialAutopsyAnalysis instance at line 196).

Commits the unbounded remark to VaSocialAutopsyAnalysis.va_saa_remark (sa.Text) in PostgreSQL and returns it in the JSON response at line 238, from where it is also read by workspace (app/routes/api/va_case.py:508), renderpartial (app/services/case_content_service.py:559), and mv_submission_analytics (app/services/submission_analytics_mv.py:945,1125).

evidence.description: save_social_autopsy parses JSON via request.get_json(force=True, silent=True) without checking request.content_length.
remark = (data.get('remark') or '').strip() or None has no character-length cap or string type check.
va_saa_remark is declared as an unbounded sa.Text column.
Config.MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH defaults to 2 * 1024 * 1024 (2 MiB) unless overridden by the MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH environment variable.
Comparable baseline finalize enforces _FREE_TEXT_CAP = 4000 characters on coder final remark (line 611).
_social_autopsy_json loads row.va_saa_remark into the GET /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/workspace response (line 754).
mv_submission_analytics materializes saa.va_saa_remark AS social_autopsy_remark across active submissions.

blockers: OS-enforced sandbox execution is unavailable on this VM (predeclared promotion allowlist is empty), preventing local runtime reproduction of the oversized remark save and subsequent workspace/analytics read.

Production and staging environment values for MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH (config.py:137, default 2 MiB behind nginx client_max_body_size 55m in deploy/ingress-routes.conf:7) are outside repository source observation.

validation_plan.local: In an isolated test database, create a project with social_autopsy_enabled=True, allocate a test submission to a dummy coder, and send a POST request to /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/social-autopsy with valid selected_options for all three delay levels and a 500,000-character remark string. Verify that HTTP 200 is returned with the 500,000-character remark persisted in va_social_autopsy_analyses.va_saa_remark and returned by GET /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/workspace?mode=coding.
validation_plan.deployment: Inspect the deployed environment configuration (without sending large payloads to shared services) to confirm whether MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH is left at the 2 MiB default in config.py:137 or overridden to a higher value, and enforce a route-level Content-Length cap (e.g., 64 KiB) and character limit (e.g., 4,000 characters) in app/routes/api/so.py.
